item.title: Metafuels and PSI receive grant from Swiss Federal Office of Energy - ESG HUB
item.description: Metafuels and the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) have received a grant of 4.4 million Swiss francs from the Swiss Federal Office of Energy to build a pilot plant for making sustainable aviation fuel (e-SAF).

item.title: New Platform for Investing in Tokenized Forests and Carbon Credits - ESG HUB
item.description: Concordium partners with Upwood.io to offer a user-friendly platform for investing in tokenized forests and carbon credits. Using blockchain technology, Upwood.io ensures secure and transparent transactions. Investors can manage their portfolios, track real-time updates, and monitor the environmental impact.

item.title: Liebherr and Fortescue Partner for Zero-Emission Mining - ESG HUB
item.description: Fortescue and Liebherr have partnered to develop zero-emission mining haul trucks. This collaboration will integrate green power technologies from Fortescue Future Industries and Williams Advanced Engineering into Liebherr's T 264 trucks. The initiative supports global emissions reduction goals and aims to offer fossil fuel-free mining equipment by 2030.

item.title: Clariant's Catalyst Selected for Green Ammonia Project in China - ESG HUB
item.description: Clariant announced that its EnviCat® Green series catalyst has been chosen for a significant green ammonia project in China.

item.title: Swiss Companies Cut CO2 Emissions by 8.9% Over Two Years - ESG HUB
item.description: Large Swiss companies have reduced their CO2 emissions by 8.9% over the past two years, according to a recent survey. The 20 largest Swiss firms emitted 81 million tonnes of CO2 in 2023, with significant reductions from Novartis and Geberit.

item.title: IBM and WWF Use AI to Protect Endangered Elephants - ESG HUB
item.description: IBM and WWF are collaborating to protect the critically endangered African forest elephants.

item.title: Carbon Standards International Receives Conditional Endorsement from ICROA - ESG HUB
item.description: Carbon Standards International (CSI) has received conditional endorsement from the International Carbon Reduction and Offset Alliance (ICROA) for its carbon certification standard.

item.title: GraphEnergyTech Secures Funding to Boost Graphene-Based Solar Cells - ESG HUB
item.description: Swiss start-up GraphEnergyTech Ltd has raised GBP 1 million in its first equity funding round, led by Aramco's venture arm. Based in Lausanne, GraphEnergyTech develops graphene electrodes for solar cells, aiming to replace silver and other precious metals while maintaining efficiency.

item.title: Swiss Federal Council Responds to European Court's Ruling on Climate Protection - ESG HUB
item.description: The Swiss Federal Council reviewed the European Court of Human Rights ruling on climate protection, affirming Switzerland's commitment to the Council of Europe. It considers Switzerland compliant with the ruling’s climate requirements, citing recent laws like the revised CO2 Act. However, the Council opposes expanding the right of associations to file climate-related complaints due to potential impacts on infrastructure projects.

item.title: Climeworks' Orca Plant Earns First AAA Rating from BeZero Carbon - ESG HUB
item.description: Climeworks' Orca plant in Iceland has become the first carbon capture project to receive an AAA rating from BeZero Carbon.
